'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Bill Kafer DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' So I'm a loser.
* '''Username:''' TacoBill
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
